LESSON: DIVERSITY AND INTERPERSONAL RELATIONSHIPS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.5: Diversity and interpersonal relationships

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Diversity and interpersonal relationships
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do varied personalities shape society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify factors that determine human diversity in the society
2. explain interpersonal skills that enhance healthy interactions in a multicultural society
3. classify the desirable and undesirable personality attributes
4. appreciate the importance of building healthy relationships in a multicultural society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
